article.story: BINGHAMTON, N.Y. -- — Gavin Walsh had 15 points in Binghamton's 79-60 win against New Hampshire on Thursday night. Walsh also had 13 rebounds, five assists, and three steals for the Bearcats (14-14, 6-7 America East Conference). Tymu Chenery scored 14 points while going 6 of 9 and 2 of 3 from the free-throw line and added nine rebounds. Ben Callahan-Gold shot 4 of 8 from the field, including 1 for 4 from 3-point range, and went 5 for 5 from the line to finish with 14 points. The Wildcats (7-21, 5-8) were led in scoring by Khalil Badru, who finished with 14 points. Both teams next play Saturday. Binghamton hosts Maine and New Hampshire goes on the road to play Albany. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
